acceptance: An owner decision on the fallback (e.g. owner approval or a named alternative reviewer) and, if adopted, oracle-review recognizing it for the exact head commit
description: oracle-review passes only on a Codex connector review or +1 after the head commit. When the connector hit its usage limit, soundness-path PRs (#2604, #2605, #2612, #2621, #2622, #2623) were reviewed by a stand-in agent and the review posted as a comment, but the check stayed red and cannot record that review. The process has no defined alternative.
